headline: 3 Easy Ways to Breed Kitsun
title: How to Breed Kitsun in Palworld | 3 Easy Combos | Palworld Guide
video_script: Here are three easy ways to breed Kitsun in Palworld one point zero. Combo one: Chikipi plus Knocklem. Chikipi is everywhere at the start, so this is the easiest one. Combo two: Lovander plus Nyafia. Combo three: Dumud plus Ragnahawk. Put the two parents on your Breeding Farm, add a cake, and the egg hatches into Kitsun, a fast Fire fox you can ride. Which Pal should I cover next? Comment below!
description: How to breed Kitsun in Palworld 1.0 - three easy combos: Chikipi + Knocklem, Lovander + Nyafia and Dumud + Ragnahawk. Each combo checked on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula.
